note: Coarse keyword-and-category heuristic, not a clinical assessment. There is no injury field in the DB — exclusion works by matching sub_category and exercise-name substrings (case-insensitive). It will over-exclude safe variants and can under-exclude. /onboard echoes the concrete exclusion list back to the user before writing the profile. See README 'Honest limitations'.

lower_back.label: Lower back pain
lower_back.note: Axially loaded and spinal-flexion work removed. Machine and supported variants preferred.

shoulder.label: Shoulder pain / impingement
shoulder.note: Overhead pressing and upright rows removed — the classic impingement-provoking movements. Horizontal pressing and lateral raises kept but flagged for caution.

knee.label: Knee pain
knee.note: Deep-flexion squat variants, single-leg squats, and jumping removed. Leg press/curl-style hinge work is not excluded but check load and range yourself.

elbow.label: Elbow pain (tennis/golfer's elbow)
elbow.note: Direct arm isolation work removed — the highest elbow-strain movements. Compound pressing/pulling that also hits arms is kept.

wrist.label: Wrist pain
wrist.note: Direct forearm/wrist work removed. These exercises carry no tracked volume credit, so nothing else in the plan changes.

hip.label: Hip pain / impingement
hip.note: Deep hip flexion, hinge, and adduction work removed. Standard squat and leg-press variants are kept but flagged for caution.

neck.label: Neck pain
neck.note: Direct neck work removed. These exercises carry no tracked volume credit, so nothing else in the plan changes.
